title: 2 Samuel
introduction: 2 Samuel records David's reign from the death of Saul and the civil war for the throne through the taking of Jerusalem and the bringing up of the ark, the Davidic covenant and the consolidation of the kingdom, the Ammonite war and the fall of David, Absalom's revolt and David's return, the famine, the Gibeonites, and the giants, and the song, the last words, and the census and the plague. These nine studies follow literary divisions; they do not claim nine independently dated historical events. Archaeology, historical reconstruction, and later interpretation are distinguished from biblical testimony.
